reuse.why: Follows the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard pattern with a sibling assertAccountIsOpen helper, though it re-queries the account that each link function then loads again for the upgrade.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only a one-line call is repeated in each of the six per-provider link functions, which is how the tree already structures these guards.

placement.why: The guard lives in server/accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guard and runs before any bank creation, update or sync.

scope.why: Adds just the guard, its six calls and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent with the existing guard; a future seventh provider must remember to add the call, as with the existing guard.

one_place.where: assertAccountIsOpen in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions
